candidates.abstract_match_explanation: This foundational textbook covers the integration of constraint networks and probabilistic models, directly addressing exact inference in combined combinatorial and probabilistic domains. It extensively details pruning and inference techniques for models with deterministic (impossible) constraints.
candidates.expert_reason: This work comprehensively investigates exact inference algorithms that exploit deterministic relations—combinations that cannot occur—alongside probabilistic graphical models to scale reasoning without approximation.

candidates.abstract_match_explanation: The paper addresses the exact core of the idea facets by using SMT-based techniques to perform inference over hybrid domains with constraints, explicitly focusing on reducing combinatorial search spaces and handling impossible/constrained assignments.
candidates.expert_reason: It addresses scaling exact hybrid inference by using SMT predicate abstraction to prune invalid configurations and drastically reduce the number of enumerated models in weighted model integration.

candidates.expert_reason: It introduces SGDPLL(T) for exact probabilistic inference parameterized by background logical theories, directly avoiding the intractable instantiation of combinations ruled out by constraints.

candidates.expert_reason: It achieves scalable exact inference over hybrid probability distributions subject to complex logical and arithmetic constraints via factorized message passing.
